verdict.rationale: Stripe documents test-mode integration and purchase simulation ('Test the integration: Simulate test purchases before going live', and a dedicated testing guide), which supports sandbox-style testing without touching production/live cards. However, evidence lacks specifics on how fully isolated the sandbox is (e.g., test-mode API keys, dedicated test data reset, coverage of all Issuing features like physical card printing in test mode) and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the sandbox experience. missing for 10: detailed documentation of test-mode isolation mechanics, independent/hands-on verification of sandbox fidelity, confirmation that all Issuing features (e.g., digital wallets, physical card issuance) are testable without live data.
